name: VOD Probe
description: Probes the real quality of each VOD relation (movies and every episode of every series version) with ffprobe in a background task and writes it into the relation's custom_properties, so every tool reading Dispatcharr's API can use it. Can also backfill missing tmdb_id/imdb_id from the provider's per-title detail endpoint, merging safely into an existing catalogue entry when one already has the id. Dry run by default.
author: oxios0x00

fields.label: Dry run (probe, but write nothing)
fields.help_text: ON: probes for real, writes nothing. OFF: writes to custom_properties.

fields.label: Batch size (movie/series relations)
fields.help_text: A run goes through everything due, this many at a time, without stopping between batches. 0 = a single batch.

fields.label: Only these movie relation ids
fields.help_text: Comma-separated. Probes exactly these instead of the normal selection. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Only these series relation ids
fields.help_text: Comma-separated. Probes exactly these series versions instead of the normal selection. Leave empty otherwise.

fields.label: Episodes: what to probe

options.label: One episode per series version, copied to all the others (default)
One episode per season, copied to the others of that season

fields.help_text: Every episode gets quality info either way; the rest are copied from a probed one and marked 'inferred'.

fields.label: Max concurrent probes
fields.help_text: Stay below the provider's connection limit.

fields.label: Stop when the error ratio exceeds
fields.help_text: Pauses the run automatically past this ratio (checked after 5 probes).

fields.label: Retry errors at the next scheduled run
fields.help_text: Retries every failed relation at the next scheduled run, then turns itself off. For a manual retry, use Retry Errors.

fields.label: Probe timeout (seconds)
fields.help_text: ffprobe gives up after this delay.

fields.label: Fetch missing tmdb_id/imdb_id
fields.help_text: OFF by default. When ON, every Probe Run (scheduled or manual) also asks the provider's per-title detail endpoint for movies/series that have neither id — the same call Dispatcharr's own UI triggers when a title's card is opened. Fetch Missing IDs below always runs on click regardless of this setting.

fields.label: Schedule (5-field cron)
fields.help_text: 'minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week', e.g. '0 4 * * *' for every day at 04:00, in Dispatcharr's time zone. Empty = no schedule. Click Apply after changing.

actions.label: Probe Run
actions.description: Starts a background run over due movies and series. Follow it with Run Status.

actions.label: Run Status
actions.description: Progress of the current run, or the result of the last one.

actions.label: Retry Errors
actions.description: Flags every failed relation so the next run tries them again.

actions.label: Reload Incomplete Series
actions.description: Finds series versions with a suspiciously short episode list and flags them for reload.

actions.label: Pause
actions.description: Stops the current run after the relation in progress; blocks new runs until Resume.

actions.label: Resume
actions.description: Lifts the pause (also set by the circuit breaker).

actions.label: Scan
actions.description: Counts the relations due for a probe and why. Writes nothing.

actions.label: Coverage Stats
actions.description: Share of relations already probed, measured vs. inferred, with tiers found.

actions.label: Fetch Missing IDs
actions.description: Starts a background run asking the provider for the tmdb_id/imdb_id of movies/series that have neither. Runs immediately regardless of the setting above; turn that on to also get this at the end of every Probe Run. Follow it with Run Status.

actions.label: [SCHEDULE] Apply
actions.description: Registers or updates the periodic Probe Run from the settings above.

confirm.title: Remove the schedule?
confirm.message: Unregisters the periodic task. You can create it again with Apply.

actions.label: [SCHEDULE] Status
actions.description: Whether a schedule is registered and when it last ran.
